notes: First-entry decomposition of 132-avoiders gives N_k(n)=sum_i N_k(i)N_{k-1-i}(n-1-i); for k=4 this collapses to N_4(n+1)=N_4(n)+N_3(n)+n+1 (n>=3), giving (n+3)(n^2-4)/6. Lean main theorem A212346.A212346_formula (Mathlib) from the recursion. Outside Lean: the decomposition (recursion counts the permutations); brute force n<=10 and KRT generating-function theorem.
